title: A Kansas Indian blanket
done: You made an Indian blanket! It is the state wildflower of Oklahoma, and it grows in Kansas too.

steps.say: Put a purple square flat on the table. It is the middle. Real ones are brown; we use purple.
Put a red square on the left.
Put a red square on the right.
Put a red square on top.
Put a red square at the bottom.
Put a yellow triangle on the left end. Yellow tips!
Put a yellow triangle on the right end.
Put a yellow triangle on the top end.
Put a yellow triangle on the bottom end.
